newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australis wraps up A$316 mln refinance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australis wraps up A$316 mln refinance.

text.p: Pay television group Australis Media Ltd said on Friday it had compeleted its A$316 million refinancing plan.
The company said it had concluded the issue of US$150 million senior notes due 2002, which repays an interim facility of US$125 million from Toronto Dominion Bank.

Australis said two of its major shareholders, Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd and United States cable company Lenfest Communications Inc, bought just more than half of the U.S. junk bonds.
It said PBL acquired about US$35.6 million of the high-yield zero coupon bonds, while Lenfest bought about US$40.0 million of the bonds.

Australis said the capital raising of A$316 million, or about US$250 million, included the raising of US$100 million in new equity with the issue of 173.144 million ordinary shares at about 54.5 cents. Australis shares were unchanged at 18.5 cents on Friday.
The share issue was based on the exercise of options or notes, or the conversion of equity conversion rights by shareholders.
Australis said that apart from repaying the interim funding facility, Lenfest Australia would also be repaid US$18.5 million of loan principal.

"The balance of the proceeds will be used to fund the continued rollout of the company's services and to repay certain other outstanding liabilities of approximately A$33 million leaving the company with sufficient cash on hand to carry the business through to cash flow positive in the near future," Australis said.
It also said it had settled the sale of regional pay television interests to United International Holdings for A$10 million.
